description: Derived, not in the specification: on_hvac_control copies LeftTemperature and RightTemperature from the HVACService event into HVACControl unchanged (float conversion only), so GWM never raises a setpoint. test_hvac.py covers the left side only. Side finding outside this goal: a missing parameter is sent as 0 °C (float(... or 0)), below the 16 °C DBC minimum. Verified by analysis instead.
metadata.name: VM_GWM_Climate_Analysis
